ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image is a structural schematic diagram of a leaf cross-section, with the letter G labeled on the right side. The indicator line of G points to a vein-like structure in the middle inside the leaf, extending horizontally and composed of tubular cells, located between the upper and lower mesophyll tissues. Reasoning: In a leaf cross-section, this kind of middle leaf vein structure that contains conducting tissue and is bundle-shaped is a vascular bundle, usually containing xylem and phloem. Therefore, G represents the vascular bundle.
